in_marathi.name: Ishtadev
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishtadev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishtadev is a compound name derived from 'Ishta' meaning desire and 'Dev' meaning God. It refers to the beloved deity or the one who is most cherished. The name carries deep spiritual significance in Hinduism, symbolizing the devotee's unwavering faith and dedication towards their chosen deity.

It refers to the beloved deity or the one who is most cherished. The name carries deep spiritual significance in Hinduism, symbolizing the devotee's unwavering faith and dedication towards their chosen deity.
